tools.name: api_catalog
tools.description: Discover every public API operation and its request schema. Filter by path or summary. Use api_request for operations without a dedicated tool.

tools.name: api_request
tools.description: Execute any public API v1 operation with the same bearer token, scopes, owner/list restrictions and validation as REST/UI. Use api_catalog first. For task syntax use quick_add/raw_text. Browser-session-only security operations still require a browser session. Binary responses are base64.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks. Default status is active. Pass status=completed|cancelled|archived|all to include others. Optional filters: tag_id, priority, from/to ([from,to), inclusive start and exclusive end in the user time zone); range_field=due|start|any (default any, including overlapping intervals). someday=true lists Someday; the default excludes them. Workflow columns (pending/in progress) are list board columns via column_id (TTD-AUD-53).

from.description: Inclusive lower bound. Civil dates use the user time zone.

to.description: Exclusive upper bound. Civil dates use the user time zone.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Read one task.

include_activity.description: Default summary; full includes stored task snapshots.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task. project_id defaults to the inbox. start_date is when you plan to do it; due_date is the deadline. someday parks it out of Today; evening_only reserves it for this evening. Pass tag_ids or tags (names; missing names are created). content is the description. parse=true runs the same quick-add parser as the app on title (#tag, ^list, !priority, natural dates). To make it REPEAT, pass `recurrence` (structured) — the task needs a due_date, which anchors the series. Examples: 'cada día' = {freq:'daily'}; 'cada lunes y jueves' = {freq:'weekly', weekdays:['MO','TH']}; 'cada 19 de mes' = {freq:'monthly', month_day:19}; 'el último viernes del mes' = {freq:'monthly', month_week:{setpos:-1, weekday:'FR'}}; 'cada día laborable' = {freq:'weekly', weekdays:['MO','TU','WE','TH','FR']}. Default interval is 1; 'cada 3 días' = {freq:'daily', interval:3}. End with until (date) or count (N times). repeat_from:'completion_date' repeats from when it was completed ('regar cada 3 días desde que lo hice'). Advanced: pass a raw RRULE string as repeat_rule instead. One occurrence exists at a time; the next one appears after completing the current (see complete_task).

include_activity.description: Default summary; full includes stored task snapshots.

parent_id.description: Parent task id to create a one-level subtask (TTD-AUD-52).

column_id.description: Board column id for workflow (pending / in progress). Prefer this over inventing workflow_state (TTD-AUD-53).

content.description: Task description (Markdown). Distinct from comments and sticky notes.

tag_ids.description: Tag UUIDs to assign (replaces the whole set when used on update_task).

tags.description: Tag names to assign; missing names are created (same as quick add).

parse.description: If true, parse title with the quick-add parser (same as the capture box). Explicit fields win over the parse.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD = all-day in the task time zone; YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm±hh:mm = timed instant.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD = all-day in the task time zone; YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm±hh:mm = timed instant.

duration_minutes.description: Kept as given. If start_date and due_date are both set within 24h, must match their span.

month_day.description: Only with freq=monthly/yearly. Positive day of month, or negative from month end (-1 = last day).

month_week.description: Only with freq=monthly: last Friday of the month = {setpos:-1, weekday:'FR'}.

until.description: End of the series (civil date in the task time zone).

repeat_rule.description: Advanced raw RRULE (optionally with DTSTART/EXDATE lines). Mutually exclusive with recurrence.

repeat_from.description: due_date (default): next from the rule grid. completion_date: from when you completed it (habits like 'water every 3 days').

tools.name: quick_add
tools.description: Capture a task from natural language (same parser as the in-app capture box): #tags, ^list, !priority, dates like «mañana 09:00-09:30».

include_activity.description: Default summary; full includes stored task snapshots.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task complete. On a repeating task the next occurrence is created by a scheduler within ~60 s unless materialize_next=true. advance controls the next date: 'one_period' (default, one period after the current due date — an overdue task may repeat in the past) or 'next_future' (first future occurrence; skipped occurrences are gone for good). Use get_task_occurrences to preview.

include_activity.description: Default summary; full includes stored task snapshots.

advance.description: How to pick the next due date for a repeating task. Default 'one_period'.

materialize_next.description: If true, create the next occurrence in this same call instead of waiting for the scheduler (~60 s).

tools.name: reopen_task
tools.description: Reopen a completed or cancelled task (409 not_reopenable if already active). Workflow columns are separate from status — use column_id when available (TTD-AUD-53).

include_activity.description: Default summary; full includes stored task snapshots.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a task (status=cancelled; hidden from lists, kept in history). Undo with reopen_task. Soft-delete is delete_task; restore with restore_task.

include_activity.description: Default summary; full includes stored task snapshots.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Soft-delete a task into trash (30-day retention). Requires tasks:trash. Use restore_task to bring it back.

tools.name: restore_task
tools.description: Restore a soft-deleted task from trash.

include_activity.description: Default summary; full includes stored task snapshots.

tools.name: list_task_comments
tools.description: List comments on a task (oldest first).

tools.name: add_task_comment
tools.description: Add a Markdown comment on a task.

tools.name: list_task_links
tools.description: List automatic and manual task links, independent of Google Drive.

tools.name: add_task_link
tools.description: Add a manual http/https/mailto task link. Private URLs are stored without fetching; optional public HTML title only.

tools.name: remove_task_link
tools.description: Remove a link from its owning task.

tools.name: list_task_attachments
tools.description: List Drive metadata including web_view_link, icon_link, source and drive_state (ok/missing/unknown). Requires Google Drive connected for uploads; files go to the connected Google Drive account; ttd stores metadata only. REST multipart streams to Drive (25 MiB/file, 50/task); direct web uploads allow 100 MiB.

tools.name: link_drive_file
tools.description: Link an existing Google Picker-authorized file to a task without copying it. Requires Google Drive connected; ttd stores metadata only (50 attachments/task).

tools.name: remove_task_attachment
tools.description: Remove Drive attachment metadata. By default the file stays in Drive. trash_in_drive:true moves it to Drive trash first; an upstream failure preserves the attachment.

tools.name: move_task
tools.description: Move a task to another list (and optionally a board column).

tools.name: add_checklist_item
tools.description: Add a checklist item on a task.

tools.name: update_checklist_item
tools.description: Rename a checklist item.

tools.name: complete_checklist_item
tools.description: Mark a checklist item complete.

tools.name: uncomplete_checklist_item
tools.description: Reopen a checklist item.

tools.name: list_task_reminders
tools.description: List reminders on a task (TTD-AUD-52).

tools.name: add_task_reminder
tools.description: Add a reminder. Relative example: type=relative, trigger=-PT15M (TRIGGER:-PT15M is also accepted; stored canonically as -PT15M) (15 minutes before due). Absolute: type=absolute, trigger=TRIGGER, absolute_at=ISO datetime.

tools.name: delete_task_reminder
tools.description: Delete a reminder from a task.

tools.name: assign_task
tools.description: Assign or unassign a task (assignee_id=null clears). Prefer one account per person plus shared lists for authorship (TTD-AUD-57).

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update a task. start_date is when you plan to do it; due_date is the deadline and may be cleared without changing when. someday=true clears when and keeps the deadline. tag_ids/tags replace the set; add_tag_ids/add_tags and remove_tag_ids/remove_tags adjust it. content updates the description. column_id sets the board workflow column. parse=true parses the new title like quick add. To change repetition pass recurrence or repeat_rule (same rules as create_task). recurrence:null (or repeat_rule:null) removes the series; changing the rule does not regenerate past occurrences or the series_id unless you clear it. To change list use move_task.

include_activity.description: Default summary; full includes stored task snapshots.

tag_ids.description: Tag UUIDs to assign (replaces the whole set when used on update_task).

tags.description: Tag names to assign; missing names are created (same as quick add).

add_tag_ids.description: Tag UUIDs to assign (replaces the whole set when used on update_task).

add_tags.description: Tag names to assign; missing names are created (same as quick add).

remove_tag_ids.description: Tag UUIDs to assign (replaces the whole set when used on update_task).

remove_tags.description: Tag names to assign; missing names are created (same as quick add).

parse.description: If true, parse title with the quick-add parser. Explicit fields win.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD = all-day in the task time zone; YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm±hh:mm = timed instant; null clears.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD = all-day in the task time zone; YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm±hh:mm = timed instant; null clears.

duration_minutes.description: Kept as given. If start_date and due_date are both set within 24h, must match their span.

month_day.description: Only with freq=monthly/yearly. Positive day of month, or negative from month end (-1 = last day).

month_week.description: Only with freq=monthly: last Friday of the month = {setpos:-1, weekday:'FR'}.

until.description: End of the series (civil date in the task time zone).

recurrence.description: Structured recurrence, or null to remove the series.

repeat_rule.description: Raw RRULE, or null to clear. Mutually exclusive with recurrence.

repeat_from.description: due_date (default): next from the rule grid. completion_date: from when you completed it (habits like 'water every 3 days').

tools.name: get_task_occurrences
tools.description: List the theoretical occurrences of a repeating task in a range. Nothing is stored: only the current occurrence exists as a row.

tools.name: detach_occurrence
tools.description: Edit or skip ONE occurrence without breaking the series: it is excluded with an EXDATE and becomes (or stops being) its own task.

include_activity.description: Default summary; full includes stored task snapshots.

tools.name: get_day_load
tools.description: Day load for a morning briefing. Counts active tasks (duration or the default estimate) plus external events overlapping the workday. Evening and Someday tasks do not count. All-day events count as zero. available_minutes is null when the workday is off.

tools.name: start_day_shutdown
tools.description: Open a shutdown session for today or yesterday. Returns what was finished and the pending queue. Nothing changes until apply_day_shutdown.

tools.name: record_shutdown_decision
tools.description: Record one shutdown decision: done, plan_day, later, someday, cancel, trash, or skip. plan_day and later take target_date.

tools.name: apply_day_shutdown
tools.description: Apply a shutdown session. Same idempotency key returns the same result. A stale expected_revision returns revision_conflict.

tools.name: discard_replan
tools.description: Discard an owned draft replan without changing tasks. Applied sessions cannot be discarded.

tools.name: replan_day
tools.description: Propose where leftover tasks should go. auto_apply defaults to false so a person can confirm before anything moves. Does not place calendar blocks.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List task lists.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a task list.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List tags.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a tag.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: List saved filters.

tools.name: create_filter
tools.description: Save a normal filter that matches a keyword.

tools.name: list_smart_lists
tools.description: List system smart lists.

tools.name: list_smart_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in one smart list.

tools.name: list_habits
tools.description: List habits.

tools.name: create_habit
tools.description: Create a daily habit.

tools.name: check_in_habit
tools.description: Record a habit check-in for a date.

tools.name: list_countdowns
tools.description: List countdowns. days and effective_date are already calculated in the user timezone.

tools.name: get_countdown
tools.description: Read one countdown with days calculated in the user timezone.

tools.name: create_countdown
tools.description: Create a countdown. Returned days are calculated in the user timezone.

tools.name: update_countdown
tools.description: Update a countdown.

tools.name: delete_countdown
tools.description: Soft-delete a countdown.

tools.name: archive_countdown
tools.description: Archive a countdown and stop its reminders.

tools.name: unarchive_countdown
tools.description: Unarchive a countdown.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search tasks, lists and tags. Each group is capped by limit (default 20, max 50).

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List notes.

tools.name: pin_sticky_note
tools.description: Pin a sticky note.

tools.name: dashboard_snapshot
tools.description: Read the dashboard KPIs.

tools.name: start_focus
tools.description: Start an owned focus session linked to a task. Rejects another running session.

tools.name: pause_focus
tools.description: Pause the current owned focus session, or the supplied session id.

tools.name: resume_focus
tools.description: Resume the current owned focus session, or the supplied session id.

tools.name: finish_focus
tools.description: Finish the current owned focus session, or the supplied session id.

tools.name: abort_focus
tools.description: Abort the current owned focus session, or the supplied session id.

tools.name: get_notification_settings
tools.description: Read the owned notification matrix, channel availability and civil quiet hours. There is no MCP tool to change account notification preferences.

tools.name: send_test_notification
tools.description: Send a real test notification only to the authenticated owner through push, email or linked Telegram; reports precise channel errors.

tools.name: update_focus_settings
tools.description: Update owned Pomodoro settings, durations, auto-start, local sound, volume and daily goal.

tools.name: get_focus_state
tools.description: Read the current owned session, focus settings and today totals.

tools.name: review_daily
tools.description: Propose a daily review. The tool does not apply it.

tools.name: list_external_calendars
tools.description: List read-only external calendars. Events cannot be edited. With include_available, also list Google calendars that can be added. Times elsewhere are ISO 8601 with an offset.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: List tasks and read-only external events in a range. External events cannot be edited. Times are ISO 8601 with an offset, in the user time zone when the event is all-day.

tools.name: add_external_calendar
tools.description: Subscribe to a Google calendar or an iCal URL and run the initial read-only sync. External events cannot be edited.

tools.name: sync_calendar
tools.description: Sync one external calendar, or every external calendar when subscription_id is omitted. Read-only for Google events.

tools.name: update_external_calendar
tools.description: Rename, recolor or hide an external calendar. Hiding keeps the events stored.

tools.name: remove_external_calendar
tools.description: Soft-delete an external calendar and its events.
